headline: Iran and Oman hold talks on reopening the Strait of Hormuz
summary: Tehran is negotiating with Oman over a shipping route while denying direct talks with the US, as oil prices fall sharply.
script: Iran says it is negotiating with Oman over reopening the Strait of Hormuz, while denying direct talks with the United States. Oil prices fell sharply after President Trump signalled a possible deal.
